mentions.name: ComputePrices
mentions.description: This website tracks AI compute prices, using 53 price collectors to gather pricing data with the goal of making the economics of AI easier to understand. Planned additions include kWh (electricity) prices and robot prices.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been working on https://computeprices.com for almost 2 years.

My goal is to better understand the economics of AI and make something useful in the process.

(Coming soon: kWh prices and robot prices)
mentions.author: lancekey
